FL-148.label: Liquid, shiny, white chrome on borders, not on buttons.

FL-170.walk: Reinstall on the same machine and run the start command; it finds the existing cloud Palace and the old threads without being told where they are.

FL-186.walk: Upgrade the Pydantic AI dependency; the Harness's own additions keep working and the new upstream features are usable.
